    Then improve with moves and swaps between GPUs whenever the global max
    KVPR strictly decreases.

    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    def cur_max():
        return max((load[g] / free[g] for g in range(gpu_num) if free[g] < GPU_MEM_SIZE),
                   default=0.0)

    for m in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):

                if free[g] >= m.model_size:
                    best = g
                    break
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot place model of size {m.model_size} GB")
        placement[best].append(m)
        load[best] += w
        free[best] -= m.model_size

        mx = cur_max()

    GPU's own resulting KVPR), among GPUs with strictly positive remaining
    memory after placement.

    Phase 2 (local search): repeatedly try moving a model off the hottest GPU
    to any other GPU if it strictly lowers the global max KVPR; stop when no
    improving move exists.

        return load / free if free > 0 else float('inf')

    def max_kvpr(loads, frees):
        best = 0.0
        for g in range(gpu_num):
            if frees[g] < GPU_MEM_SIZE:  # only GPUs with models count
                best = max(best, kvpr(loads[g], frees[g]))
        return best

    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num  # remaining memory per GPU
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num               # sum of req_rate/slo per GPU

    for model in sorted_models:
        w = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best_idx, best_key = None, None

            new_free = free_mem[gpu_id] - model.model_size
            if new_free <= 0:
                continue
            own = (load[gpu_id] + w) / new_free
            glob = own
            for g in range(gpu_num):
                if g != gpu_id and free_mem[g] < GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                    glob = max(glob, kvpr(load[g], free_mem[g]))
            key = (glob, own)

                best_key, best_idx = key, gpu_id

                    best_idx = gpu_id
                    break

            raise ValueError(f"Cannot place model of size {model.model_size} GB")

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        load[best_idx] += w
        free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        cur_max = max_kvpr(load, free_mem)
        # Pass A: try moving any model from any GPU to any other GPU
        for src in range(gpu_num):

                w = m.req_rate / m.slo

                        continue

                    load[dst] += w; free_mem[dst] -= m.model_size

                        placement[src].remove(m)
                        placement[dst].append(m)

                    load[dst] -= w; free_mem[dst] += m.model_size
                if improved:
                    break

            continue

        hot = max((g for g in range(gpu_num) if placement[g]),

            for dst in range(gpu_num):

                    free_mem[hot] += m.model_size - m2.model_size
